text:
Maya: Hi — I just got a surprise balance bill from an imaging center for an MRI done during the week I transitioned between jobs. I enrolled in COBRA but the new employer plan says the service date was outside their coverage so they denied it. Has anyone dealt with balance billing and COBRA overlap?
Priya (People Ops): Ugh, thats annoying. Two quick tracks: 1) confirm whether COBRA was effective on or before the MRI date; 2) ask the provider to bill the prior plan first (COBRA/continuation should be primary if it covers that date). Can you DM the bill and any EOBs?
Maya: COBRA election was submitted and accepted, effective 2026-03-01. MRI was 2026-02-25, so its in the gap. Provider billed new plan 03/02 and it denied for "not covered - date prior to coverage start." Now they're sending a $1,240 balance bill.
Liam (Benefits): If the service predates COBRA effective date, standard coverage wouldn't apply. But sometimes employers retroactively accept election back to termination date if election within 60 days and premium paid. If thats the case, we can ask COBRA admin to retro-authorize and reprocess the claim. Please send: signed COBRA election form, proof of premium payment, termination date, itemized provider bill, and the EOB from the new plan. Email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "COBRA retro request - Maya".
Anu (Broker): Also check if the provider billed the wrong payer sequence. They should bill the prior carrier (employer A) first. If employer A paid/denied, we need that EOB. If employer A never saw it, provider can rebill to employer A. If provider refuses, we can escalate with a provider advocate — include provider contact and bill codes.
Maya: Any advice on negotiating with provider for lower balance while appeal pending?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — call billing, ask for an appeal/financial assistance hold and note you're pursuing an insurance appeal. Ask for itemized charges and a timeline hold (30-60 days). Document the conversation (agent name, time). We can also offer a template letter if you want.
Maya: That would help, thanks.
benefits-bot: COBRA retro checklist & template: https://benefits.redwood.com/cobra-retro-checklist.pdf — include signed election, premium payment proof, termination letter, itemized bill, and any EOBs. Submit to benefits@redwood.com.
Liam (Benefits): Once you email, ping me and Ill flag it as priority. If COBRA admin approves retro coverage, provider can be asked to resubmit and balance bill should be voided.
Maya: Sent email with subject "COBRA retro request - Maya" and attached forms. Called billing and got a 60-day hold. Will update when I hear back. Thanks all for fast help.
